plan.notes: Source: HSU official 2026-2027 Degree Plans index, BBA + Managerial Accounting Certificate (2026-2027 Catalog) PDF, 'Updated 05/01/2026'. Header states the plan is 'a suggested plan of study' and 'does not substitute for the HSU catalog'. Genuine term-by-term sequence sums 16+16+15+15+15+15+15+13 = 120. '*' = C or better required. Numbered footnotes are prerequisites: 1 = ENGL 10103; 2 = MATH 11003 or 1273 & computer proficiency; 3 = BUSI 23263; 4 = 45 earned credit hours; 5 = ACCT 23003, ECON 21403, & BUSI 23263; 6 = ACCT 23003 & ECON 21403; 7 = FINN 30403, MGMT 30073, MGMT 35073; 8 = 60 earned credit hours; 9 = BUSI 21003 & MGMT 30073 or equivalent; 10 = MGMT 30073; 11 = FINN 30403; BUSI 20103, 3113, MGMT 35243; MGMT 35073; take within 18 hours of graduation. All footnote prereqs resolve to in-plan courses, so no external_prereqs. Junior Spring 'BUSI 20103 Management Communications* OR ENGL 36043 Writing for the Workspace*' and Senior Fall 'BUSI 40003 Internship in Business OR BUSI 41703 Business Mentorship Experience' are choice slots (first-listed code shown). 'Directed Elective Options: See your faculty advisor to discuss elective options' — the Directed Business Elective slots (Junior Fall, Junior Spring, Senior Fall, Senior Spring) name only the slot, not a course: ELECTIVE placeholders with choice=true. 'US History / American Govt.', 'Humanities', 'Natural Science', 'Non-Western Cultures', and 'Free Elective' likewise name only the slot: ELECTIVE placeholders with choice=true.
